versions.name: Rocky Mountain High Adventure Base

features.note: An ADA-accessible shower room is available on request.
A sixteen-stall showerhouse with individual lockable rooms.
A dining hall with an outdoor patio.
Two flush toilets behind the medical lodge; most camp restrooms are vault or pit toilets.
The Dr. Matthew T. Sumpter Medical Lodge, staffed by the camp health officer.
Canvas wall tents pitched on wooden platforms.

versions.summary: High-adventure base at San Isabel Scout Ranch in Colorado's Wet Mountains, offering whitewater rafting, climbing and rappelling, mountain biking, and peak summits.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). The stored page describes shared San Isabel Scout Ranch facilities, four of whose campsites are designated for this base.
